supersession_reason: DERIVED-IAMAtlas-ONLY. The pooled-cohort centroid/covariance is retired. The healthy reference is the derived floor (A=1.0) and the derived tier-band spread. No GEO, no pooled cohort, no comparison to populations of healthy or sick people.
mu_derivation: Healthy sits at the architectural floor by construction: A=H(beta)/H_min=1.0 when entropy is at the class floor. Confirmed on real healthy blood at class level (immune 0.993, secretory 0.986, cycling 0.992, progenitor 1.005). mu is a derived constant, NOT read from the atlas means (which sit off-floor at discriminative markers) and NOT a cohort mean.
sigma_derivation: Derived NORMAL band [0.95,1.04) anchored at floor 1.0. ELEVATED onset 1.04 = +2 sigma (the 95% healthy reference interval) => sigma=(1.04-1.0)/2=0.02. Uniform across all cell types because the A-score is H_min-normalized (floor=1.0 for every class) and the NORMAL band is defined globally. The suppressed edge 0.95 sits at -2.5 sigma (slightly more conservative; suppression is the rarer disease signal).
covariance_note: Diagonal Sigma = sigma^2 I. Distance = sqrt( sum_c ((A_c - 1)/sigma)^2 ) over substrate-assessable cell types. Off-diagonal (cross-cell-type) correlations are population-empirical and are deliberately NOT used; including them would reintroduce a cohort.
assessable_gating: Distance is summed ONLY over cell types the Stage-2 presence gate marks assessable in the patient's substrate (A not None). Non-assessable cells are EXCLUDED, not imputed at any reference value.
provenance: No GEO. No pooled cohort. Derived from IAMAtlas H_min floors + physics-derived tier breakpoints (tier_breakpoints.json NORMAL band).
calibration_note: Distance scale differs from the retired pooled artifact; the old Cohen's d anchors do NOT carry over. Route A is calibrated ANALYTICALLY, not from a cohort: under the healthy floor distance^2 = sum z^2 ~ chi^2(n_assessable), so the alarm threshold is sqrt(chi2.ppf(p, n_assessable)) at p95/p99, n-adaptive. Validated: healthy false-positive ~5%/1% at p95/p99 across n=20-115; disease fires at >=4/40 elevated cells.
